neighbours.label: a word after which 'into' is the expected next word (bumped, crashed, N minutes/pages as elapsed progress), a next-token predictor for 'into', as against matched words that do not set up 'into'
fire: While shopping for bread, my father bumped into his old teacher.
The cyclist lost control and crashed into a parked van.
Just five minutes into the lecture, the fire alarm went off.
She was only forty pages into the report when her boss called.
Three hours into the flight, the pilot announced a delay.
Late at night the drunk driver slammed into the shop window.
Barely ten seconds into the race, two runners tripped.
Halfway home, the boy ran smack into a lamppost.
